Where Safari Days End With
Great Food

We offer great variety and creativity in our menu, with high quality food and generous portions. Our restaurant serves traditional African delicacies from all corners of Tanzania, prepared with passion. We offer a style and taste of food to suit every palate. Patamu Restaurant combines warm hospitality, a welcoming bar, and a relaxed dining atmosphere to create a memorable experience.

View our menu

Lunch in the Wild

Patamu serves fresh, hot three-course bush lunches in Ngorongoro National Park, Tarangire National Park, and Lake Manyara National Park. This is an important service for tour companies that want to improve their safari packages.

Some lodges offer this experience only when guests stay on their property. Patamu makes it easier by offering the same memorable Out of Africa style lunch with the chance of wildlife passing by.
